purpose: Teach: 蠅/襪/繩/簑/襦/其/其の/舛

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「蠅、つまり虫の生態」を絵本で見せて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you a picture book about flies — their ecology, right?
lines.style: Warm, slightly wondering tone. Speaking as if sharing in Sho's discovery. Gentle cadence, like she's pleased to know this detail about his day. A soft smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと足袋、つまり襪の博物館に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to a museum with Dad — about tabi, you know, those socks for sandals.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice. Opening with energy and pride in the outing. Natural kid-enthusiasm without overacting. Quick pace, like he can't wait to share. Slight breathlessness at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「繩、つまり縄の文化史」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught you about rope — the whole cultural history of it.
lines.style: Same gentle wondering as before. Slightly slower pace this time, letting the idea settle. Reflective, like she's thinking alongside him about what his dad chose to share.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「簑、つまり蓑」の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a picture book with Dad — about raincoats, the old kind.
lines.style: Bright again, but this time with a note of genuine interest in what he's remembering. Kid-voice, not performing. Quick and clear, eager to report the next thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「襦袢、つまり襦」を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you a juban — that undergarment.
lines.style: Quieter this time, more intimate. Like she's acknowledging something specific his father chose to show him. Slight pause before the explanation, as if she's considering it alongside him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「其の意味」を尋ねたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I asked Dad what it all meant.
lines.style: Genuine earnestness in the voice. Not childish-sounding, but sincerely curious. Slower pace, showing he's been thinking about this. Light, no strain — just a kid who noticed something bigger.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「其、汝が見る空」って詩を朗読されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad recited a poem for you — "That sky you see."
lines.style: Gentle reverence in the delivery. Slower, more measured pace. Like she's honoring what his father did. Warm undertone — this moment matters to her too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「漢字の舛違い」を指摘して頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad pointed out a mistake in the kanji I was looking at.
lines.style: Satisfied, thoughtful close. Pride that his dad noticed, taught him. Not boastful — just genuine. Warm and settled, like the conversation is complete.
